changes.release_notes:
Meet the new Essembl!

A brand-new design, built around four tabs:

• Today: daily outfits for the weather and your plans, at the time you choose
• Studio: build outfits on a canvas, get ideas and a Rate me score
• Rate my look: snap a selfie, get tips, add what you're wearing to your wardrobe
• Shop: find what your wardrobe is missing, and style it with your own clothes

Plus outfit folders, a new widget, sharing to WhatsApp, and lots of fixes.

What to wear? Already sorted.
Planner now suggests outfits based on your wardrobe and the weather, so getting dressed feels easier. You can also plan ahead for trips, weekends and events by changing your location.

- Now we support dark mode
- New home screen widgets: see today’s outfit suggestion and your OOTD without opening the app
- Bug fixes and improvements
